draftBefore.emotion: warm and approving, nodding with a slight smile
notes: "Tốt" is the standard, everyday word for good, whether describing quality, character, or general pleasantness.
Do not confuse it with "đẹp", which specifically refers to physical beauty or good looks rather than quality or moral goodness.
